findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: site_check, url_trust, can_fetch, link_check, email_validate, ssl_cert, links_batch, sitemap_urls, link_preview, canonical_check, cors_check, text_chunk, feed_parse, page_diff, pdf_text, verdict_card, page_markdown, page_meta, email_auth, seo_page, seo_audit_lite · Private data: agent_readiness, dns_lookup, domain_rdap, ip_info, sitemap_urls, cors_check, domain_lookalike, text_chunk, token_count, json_validate, url_clean, pdf_text, email_auth, site_verdict · Public sink: email_validate, text_chunk, token_count, json_validate, json_repair, url_clean, page_diff, verdict_card, email_auth, site_snapshot · Destructive: cron_next.
